Brown at (21,21). To reach (45,45) need dy=+24, dx=+24. Brown can move down (dy=+6) via action 2 (6 down). Also can move right (dx=+6) via action 4. So need 4 down moves (4*6=24) and 4 right moves (4*6=24). Sequence possible: down 4 times, right 4 times, in any order. So reachable.

Option 3: explore no goal. But there are specific actions, likely a goal.
